Vendored three.js r0.184.0 — provenance record
==============================================

These files were downloaded from unpkg and verified byte-identical to the
sha384 hashes that were previously pinned in each page's import map.

The import map no longer carries an `integrity` block, and that is not a
downgrade: subresource integrity guards against a THIRD PARTY serving you
different bytes. These files are now same-origin, served from the same
GitHub Pages deployment as the HTML that loads them. There is no third party
left to guard against, and anyone who can alter these files can equally alter
the hashes next to them.

What replaces it is this record. To confirm a vendored file still matches the
authentic upstream release:

    curl -sL https://unpkg.com/three@0.184.0/build/three.webgpu.js \
      | openssl dgst -sha384 -binary | openssl base64 -A
